note: Two primitive campgrounds about 1 km apart on the same area road, each with a privy. The larger is a gravel loop of eight or nine pull-in spurs on a wooded knoll above Schell Lake's south shore; the smaller, three or four spurs, is beside the Atkinson Lake boat ramp. No open fires. The area reopened in October 2026 after a wetland renovation, and Schell Lake is closed to fishing while the fishery rebuilds. Parts of the area, Atkinson Lake among them, are refuge closed to all public use Oct 15 to Mar 1. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: two mapped primitive campgrounds (brochure, 9/2026 map, two GIS points), both built gravel loops with privies. Area reopened 2026-10-03 after renovation. Pin is on the smaller (Atkinson Lake) camp, which appears to sit inside the Oct 15-Mar 1 Wildlife Refuge hatching - pin move to the larger north camp flagged. Waterfront lead DOWN lakefront -> lakeview (trees between at both). Privy written; phone matches.

I cannot be certain the little peninsula itself is inside the line. The north camp is in the solid 'taking of wildlife with firearms prohibited' zone beside the cross-hatched Waterfowl Refuge (Schell Lake) and is not itself hatched as refuge. Stored season (manual): year_round with the note 'Portions of the area are closed to protect waterfowl, October 15 through March 1' - left as is; if the pin stays on the south camp the season should probably be opens 03-02 / closes 10-14. MDC: (417) 853-4595.
